title: Krawtchouk diagonalizes the Shaw operator: the worst far-line incidence is a Krawtchouk-weighted Gauss period (F3 = F2 ⊗ F4-ball)
evidence: The three landed bricks are real and axiom-clean (read in tree): LineIncidenceSpectral.lineIncidence_spectral + ShawOperator.incidence_eq_average_add_shaw give I·|V| = |F|·(|S| + 𝒮) with 𝒮 = Σ_{ψ⊥s₁,ψ≠0} 1̂_S(ψ)ψ(s₀); ShellFourierKrawtchouk.shell_fourier proves Σ_{wt(e)=k}ψ(e)=K_k(charWeight ψ) (so 1̂_S(ψ)=Σ_{k≤δN}K_k(wt ψ)). PROVEN PART: the COMPOSED identity I(δ)=avg+(|F|/|V|)·Σ_{ψ⊥s₁,ψ≠0}(Σ_{k≤δN}K_k(wt ψ))ψ(s₀) is exact — probe_C017_endtoend_chain.py enumerates F_q^N (q∈{2,3,5}, N≤4) with monomial far-line s₁ and matches the TRUE incidence to 1e-16 in every case (5/5). So C017's central identity holds; the attack-plan target incidence_eq_krawtchouk_gausssum would land. REFUTED PART (the insight claim 'sign-oscillation gives cancellation the raw |η_b| sup-norm misses' / 'Krawtchouk weight DECAYS high-|b| periods'): probe_C017_krawtchouk_lever.py + probe_C017_lever_vs_supnorm.py at PRIZE proper-subgroup primes (n=8 q=521/4129, n=16 q=4129/65537, n=32 q=1048609; all μ_n proper, q≈n^3-4) show the ball factor W(x)=Σ_{k≤δN}K_k(x) is DOMINATED by its (q−1)^k term so |W| spans 10^6-10^22 across weights and grows like q^{δN} — a magnitude AMPLIFIER, not an O(1) sign-reweight. The weighted house ratio |Σ_b W_b η_b|/(max_b|W_b|·B) = 0.012-0.28 (NOT → 0 in regime, B=max|η_b|), i.e. the weighted sum tracks a single dominant-|W| term: no extra cancellation, the open content is STILL exactly B=max_b|η_b|, the BGK/Paley eigenvalue. The Krawtchouk weight multiplies the difficulty by a known huge scalar; it does not help estimate η_b.
honest_note: The composition is a genuine, exactly-verified identity (PROVEN as an identity, not as a closure). What is REDUCED-not-closed: the open input becomes 'bound the Krawtchouk-weighted Gauss-period sum max over far lines', which factors into (known q^{δN}-scale Krawtchouk weights) × (the still-open max_b|η_b|). The connection's W label is W-Johnson, but the surviving open object is max_b|η_b| = the generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue (BGK / Paley Graph Conjecture, 25-yr open), NOT a Johnson-side gap — same wall as C015/C021/C031/face-3. I did NOT formalize the ball-version shawError lemma in Lean (the attack plan's incidence_eq_krawtchouk_gausssum); the end-to-end identity is verified numerically-exactly instead, which is sufficient to confirm the chain composes. Probes use exact integer Krawtchouk arithmetic; the η_b sums are exact-field, magnitudes via double-precision (well-separated, no precision risk). Should be logged to DISPROOF_LOG as: 'Krawtchouk ball weighting is an amplifier (q^{δN}), not a sup-norm-beating cancellation lever; weighted house collapses to max|η_b|'.
reduced_to: Bound, over far (monomial) lines, the Krawtchouk-weighted Gauss-period sum Σ_{ψ⊥s₁,ψ≠0}(Σ_{k≤δN}K_k(wt ψ))ψ(s₀). Since the weight K-factor is a known deterministic q^{δN}-scale magnitude (no useful sign cancellation across surviving frequencies), this is equivalent to the BGK sup-norm B=max_{b≠0}|Σ_{y∈μ_n}e_p(by)| — the same open core, now with an explicit (non-helping) Krawtchouk envelope attached.
wall: BGK / Paley-Graph-Conjecture sup-norm of μ_n Gauss periods (max_b|η_b|). The connection's stated W-Johnson is a mislabel: the residual welds to BGK/Paley, not the Johnson-capacity gap.
